A house raid in a village in Jhansi district of Uttar Pradesh took an unexpected turn when police found illicit liquor flowing from a handpump, according to reports. The pump, ordinarily a source of water, was instead being used to dispense illegal alcohol.

During the same operation, officers also unearthed alcohol barrels buried underground, pointing to a concealed stockpile at the site.

A woman was arrested in connection with the case, reports said. The arrest was the immediate outcome of a raid that turned up liquor in an unlikely place.
